authorization.scope_note: ONE formal Phase-C3 session: replay the frozen pre-ATTENTION parent under its digest gate, gate the incumbent B, materialize three initializations once each, train 9 recovery probes (3 arms x 3 fresh seeds), evaluate each once on c1_confirmation_v1, compute the three prespecified paired contrasts with a 20,000-iteration stratified prompt-cluster bootstrap, apply the frozen decision rule to the PRIMARY contrast alone, collect evidence and tear down.
authorization.enforcement: the launcher loads this artifact and refuses to create a pod whose priced hard threshold exceeds hard_cap_usd or per_launch_hard_usd, refuses a stage not in authorized_stages, refuses a harness that does not digest to the authorized value, and has no code path to any experiment after Phase A
authorization.scope: 3 arms x 3 fresh seeds = 9 fixed 0.86M recovery probes on one frozen path, evaluated once each on c1_confirmation_v1. The PRIMARY contrast is causal-B1 - incumbent B and owns the sole GO/NO_GO/INCONCLUSIVE verdict; the secondary (causal-B3 - causal-B1) and practical (causal-B3 - B) contrasts are reported completely and may not replace it. No search, no ranking, no successive halving, no tie-breaking, no arm elimination, no fourth seed, and no authorization to start C4.
